name: Hamegui!! ~Kuro Gyaru Bitch, Inaka e Ikuu!~
original_name: ハメグイ!! ～黒ギャルビッチ、田舎へイクぅ！～
source: A promiscuous, hedonistic young woman moves to the countryside.  On her first day there, she is confessed to by an innocent young man, so she takes his virginity.  Satisfied with the outcome, she sets herself a goal of sleeping with as many other men as possible.
translation: A promiscuous, hedonistic young woman moves to the countryside.  On her first day there, she is confessed to by an innocent young man, so she takes his virginity.  Satisfied with the outcome, she sets herself a goal of sleeping with as many other men as possible.
